metadata.description: Cartesian targets are translated by trajectory_z_offset_m before IK. Arm IK compares the continuous previous solution with the recorded arm-state seed and may use a position-only fallback when the translated TCP pose cannot meet the full wrist-orientation constraint. Dex3 hand joints are taken directly from the recorded dual-hand grasp and smoothed in joint space without finger IK. Dense motor frames add smoothstep interpolation between solved target frames for Viser replay and real-robot execution planning.

cartesian_targets.description: Exact duplicate of the previous stage's final motor target; the recorded hand motion begins on the following frame.
